terrain.note: Octave persistence (a constant 0.53 in the source kernel) became the TERRAIN_ROUGHNESS slider for the garden.

peers.note: Every peer is the local character body reused verbatim — one shared sg_figure_sdf, not a second figure implementation — so other players are made of exactly the same code you are.

sponge.note: A Menger sponge. The whole project started here: the idea was hide-and-seek inside one.
